title: 도시재정비 촉진을 위한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text: Article 4 (Interest on Returned Compensation for Infrastructure) The term "interest prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport" in the former part of Article 11 (4) of the Special Act on the Promotion of Urban Renewal means interest accruing during the period from the date compensation is received until the day immediately preceding the date on which it is returned. In such cases, the applicable interest rate shall be the average interest rate on three-year time deposits offered by financial institutions licensed under the Banking Act whose business areas extend nationwide, as at the time the compensation is returned. <Amended on March 14, 2008; March 23, 2013>
